title: Migrate Doc. Exchange and OCR service callers off Http Web Request Mgt.
summary: Document Exchange and OCR service codeunits migrate from DotNet Http Web Request Mgt to native HttpClient, removing DotNet dependencies while maintaining backward-compatible public signatures.
key_points: Doc. Exch. Service Mgt. and OCR Service Mgt. now use native HttpClient, HttpRequestMessage and HttpResponseMessage instead of Http Web Request Mgt.
Credentials, form bodies and auth headers are handled as SecretText with NonDebuggable
DotNet XML parsing replaced by native XmlDocument and XML DOM Management overloads
Embedded attachments are decoded with Base64 Convert into a Temp Blob instead of DotNet File/Convert and a server temp file
OCR session cookie uses the native Cookie type with explicit re-authentication when missing or expired
quote: It follows #10755 (merged) and #12254 (draft) and uses the same patterns.
